color_space: original E0 preprocessed observation RGB, encoded 8-bit [0,255], no exposure correction
color_gate: max channel range over every original observation in the proposed union <= threshold
candidate_order: target pixel, minimum worst-channel distance of candidate color bounds to target RGB, stable current point index
geometry: same E0b nearest-pixel projective association and unweighted current-representative camera-Z mean; accepted old points removed, rejected/unprojected old points retained
gt_scale: reuse E3b -002 initial-E0b scale unchanged; no E0c refit; GT loaded only after fusion
gt_mask: fixed raw E0 valid front-Z and GT; common support of E0/E0b/E0c plus per-method coverage
